LOCS.name: Graveyard
LOCS.text: Draw 3 cadavers. Resolve any you like for materials or expertise.
LOCS.yields: Stage III to IV muscle and organs, bone

LOCS.name: Public Square
LOCS.text: Pay 1 franc for one of the executed bodies on display. Only after an execution.
LOCS.yields: Stage I, the freshest you can get

LOCS.name: Morgue
LOCS.text: Pay 1 franc, draw 2 unclaimed cadavers, resolve any.

LOCS.name: Slaughterhouse
LOCS.text: Take 4 animal at stage II, or 3 at stage I.
LOCS.yields: Animal stands in for most materials, for a little less VP

LOCS.name: Hospital
LOCS.text: Retrieve a cadaver (reputation 7+), work a shift, or volunteer.
LOCS.yields: Stage I to II materials, francs, humanity

LOCS.name: Academy
LOCS.text: Research for cards and expertise, lecture, or donate for reputation.

LOCS.name: Market
LOCS.text: Sell bone and preserved flesh. Buy Leyden jars and ice.

LOCS.name: Docks
LOCS.text: Hire one of the three scoundrels on offer.

LOCS.name: Dark Alley
LOCS.text: Murder for fresh materials. Costs 3 humanity and earns a police marker.
LOCS.yields: Stage I muscle 4, organ 4, blood 3, bone 2

LOCS.name: Saint-Roch
LOCS.text: Take a humanity card. A scientist also gains 1 humanity.

LOCS.name: First Player

spaces.n: Become first player for the next day

LOCS.text: Become first player. Can’t be bumped. When everyone has finished, you may move this meeple to another space and use it.

LOCS.name: Théâtre de l’Odéon
LOCS.text: Opening night. +2 reputation. Each player may go once; bumping here is free and sends the meeple home.

RESEARCH.name: Countermeasures
RESEARCH.text: Cancels a rival’s humanity card aimed at you (used automatically).

RESEARCH.name: Unethical Experiment
RESEARCH.text: At the Dark Alley or hiring a Cutthroat: spend 1 charged jar and skip the normal benefit.

RESEARCH.name: Pickling Jars
RESEARCH.text: At the Market: +1 franc for every sale of preserved flesh.

RESEARCH.name: Steady Hands
RESEARCH.text: When building a part: need 1 fewer of each material.

RESEARCH.name: Guest Lecturer
RESEARCH.text: When lecturing: gain this as well.

RESEARCH.name: Healing Salve
RESEARCH.text: Remove all damage from your parts.

RESEARCH.name: Burning the Candle
RESEARCH.text: On your turn: use one of your placed meeples’ spaces again, paying its costs. It is not a new placement.

RESEARCH.name: Fresh as Morning
RESEARCH.text: When resolving a cadaver: its materials count as stage I.

RESEARCH.name: Close Dissection
RESEARCH.text: When resolving a stage I or II cadaver: pay its cost, discard it, gain this instead.

RESEARCH.name: Electrolysis
RESEARCH.text: When resolving a stage I to III cadaver: spend 1 charged jar, pay its cost, discard it, gain this instead.

RESEARCH.name: Public Galvanism
RESEARCH.text: Spend 1 charged jar and 2 animal to make a dead dog dance for a crowd.

RESEARCH.name: Transfusion
RESEARCH.text: When giving blood: gain this instead of the blood.

RESEARCH.name: Publish a Paper
RESEARCH.text: On your turn: your unplaced scientist sits out this round to write.

HUMANITY.name: Whisper to the Captain
HUMANITY.text: Pay 1 franc: the Captain moves 1 step closer to the end. Not from Day 11. One aid card per day.

HUMANITY.name: Fund the Captain
HUMANITY.text: Pay 2 francs: the Captain moves 1 step closer to the end. Not from Day 11. One aid card per day.

HUMANITY.name: Tell the Captain Everything
HUMANITY.text: The Captain moves 1 step closer to the end. Not from Day 11. One aid card per day.

HUMANITY.name: Petition the Prefect
HUMANITY.text: All cadavers waiting at the Hospital are given a burial.

HUMANITY.name: A Trap of Your Own
HUMANITY.text: When the Creature visits you, spend 1 charged jar to send him away.

HUMANITY.name: Royal Pardon
HUMANITY.text: When an execution is announced, pay 2 francs to stop it.

HUMANITY.name: A Decent Burial
HUMANITY.text: When buying a body at the Public Square, bury it instead.

HUMANITY.name: Night at the Graves
HUMANITY.text: The Graveyard and hiring Body Snatchers are closed for the rest of today.

HUMANITY.name: Shame the Morgue
HUMANITY.text: The Morgue is closed for the rest of today.

HUMANITY.name: Mercy for Beasts
HUMANITY.text: When lecturing, argue against vivisection instead of gaining the normal benefit.

HUMANITY.name: Walk the Quays
HUMANITY.text: The Docks are closed for the rest of today.

HUMANITY.name: Cut the Wires
HUMANITY.text: Choose a rival: their next throw of the switch loses 1 die.

HUMANITY.name: Cross Their Path
HUMANITY.text: The next rival to place in Paris must choose a different space.

HUMANITY.name: The Dignity of the Dead
HUMANITY.text: When lecturing, speak for the dead instead of gaining the normal benefit.

HUMANITY.name: Urchin Raid
HUMANITY.text: Choose a rival: throw away up to 3 of their materials, one of each colour.

HUMANITY.name: A Careless Lantern
HUMANITY.text: Choose a rival with 2+ research cards: one of them burns.
